answers.core: Implementing this feature as an add-on in the asset library might not provide the same level of optimization and integration with other engine features, such as frustum culling and occlusion culling. Therefore, including this feature in the core engine would be the most effective approach.
answers.workaround: While it is possible to implement a custom world partitioning system using scripts, having this feature as part of the core engine would provide a more efficient and seamless solution. It would also benefit a wide range of projects, especially those with large game worlds or heavy assets. Integrating this feature into the core engine would ensure better performance, easier implementation, and consistent behavior across different platforms and hardware configurations.
